name: store_argument_in_new_handle
description: Obtains a handle from one library vector and, if it is non-null, stores the caller's argument at a fixed offset inside it and calls a second library vector. Returns whether a handle was obtained.

name: open_two_libraries_init_list
description: Opens two libraries by name through the exec library base, and on success initialises an empty self-linked list inside the structure and records its head. On failure it closes and frees the structure instead.

name: close_library_and_free_struct
description: Closes the library base held in a global, then frees the structure passed by the caller with FreeMem, and returns zero.

name: unload_idle_entries_free_record
description: Walks a linked list and removes entries with no remaining users, unloading their segments through dos; when no users remain it closes the libraries, frees the record and returns its stored result, otherwise it flags the record as pending removal.

name: free_or_mark_pending_record
description: When the record has no users and no entries left, closes the two library bases, unlinks and frees the record, and returns its stored result; otherwise it sets the pending-removal flag and returns zero.

name: mark_record_pending_removal
description: Sets the high bit of a status byte in the record to mark it as pending removal, then returns zero.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Empty routine that returns at once without doing any work.

name: clear_flag_increment_users
description: Clears the pending-removal bit in the record's status byte and increments its user counter by one.

name: decrement_user_count_release
description: Decrements the record's user counter; if the counter stays non-zero and the pending-removal bit is set, it calls a library vector and returns that result, otherwise it returns zero.

name: stub_return_zero_handler
description: Returns zero immediately without any other work.

name: collect_named_entries_into_buffer
description: Fills a caller buffer with name records: when the first flag bit is set it copies the names from a linked list of records, and when the second flag bit is set it allocates a work block and scans a directory, appending matching entries. Returns the unused byte count.

name: append_list_and_directory_entries
description: Writes name records from a linked list into a buffer and then, when the second flag bit is set, appends entries found by scanning a directory; returns the number of bytes still unused.

name: scan_directory_entries_into_buffer
description: After the list is exhausted, scans a directory when the second flag bit is set, allocating a work block, locking the directory and writing each matching entry's name and fields into the buffer; returns the unused byte count.

name: scan_fonts_directory_entries
description: Scans the FONTS: directory with examine and next-entry library calls, writing each matching .font file entry and its fields into the caller buffer; returns the unused byte count.

name: emit_directory_entry_records
description: Steps through directory entries one at a time, copying each entry's name and fields into the buffer as a record, then releases the work block and returns the remaining count.

name: parse_read_buffer_records
description: Copies bytes from a read buffer into a name field until its fixed length is reached, emitting one record per filled field and advancing through the file data with the dos read call.

name: read_records_then_close_file
description: Reads records from the file through the dos read call, copying each name into the buffer and emitting a record, then closes the file handle and returns the remaining count.

name: unlock_and_release_scan_state
description: Unlocks the directory lock saved in the scan state, runs two more library cleanup calls, and returns the remaining buffer count.

name: stub_return_zero_status
description: Returns zero immediately without any other work.

name: score_record_differences
description: Returns a distance score between two records: it adds a base value from the first record's 16-bit field, then for each of seven bit positions in two flag bytes subtracts a table weight wherever the bits differ. If the reference field is zero it returns a fixed sentinel instead.

name: score_record_bit_differences
description: Starts from a base value derived from two register inputs, then subtracts a table weight for each of seven bit positions where the flag bytes of the two records differ, and returns the score.

name: subtract_weights_per_bit_flags
description: Walks seven bit positions and subtracts a table weight from a running total whenever a mask bit and a flag byte of the record agree, returning the total.

name: subtract_weights_for_masked_bits
description: Walks seven bit positions in the opposite order to the sibling scorer, subtracting table weights for set mask bits from the record's two flag bytes, and returns the running total.

name: return_fixed_negative_sentinel
description: Returns a fixed negative sentinel value of minus 32767 without other work.

name: find_best_matching_font_entry
description: Searches the FONTS: directory for the entry that scores best against the requested font name, links a matching font entry into the font list and registers it, then returns the chosen record.

name: match_font_entry_via_read
description: Reads font directory data through the dos read call, scores each record against the requested name and links the best-scoring font entry into the list, returning the selected record.

name: pick_best_font_entry_loop
description: Repeatedly selects the highest-scoring record from a table, links each font-type record into the font list and registers it, and returns the last matched record once no scoring records remain.

name: link_highest_scoring_font_entries
description: Scans a table of records keeping the highest-scoring one, and for each selected font-type entry loads its segment, adds it to the list and registers it with the graphics library, returning the last matched entry.

name: unload_entry_and_pick_next
description: Unloads the segment of one table entry through the dos library and clears its slot, then repeatedly selects the highest-scoring remaining record, linking font-type records into the list.

name: close_and_unlink_font_entries
description: Clears one table slot and repeatedly selects the highest-scoring record, linking font-type records into the font list; afterwards it closes the file, unlocks the directory and closes the font record before returning.

name: forbid_task_switching
description: Calls the exec Forbid routine through the library base to disable task switching.

name: permit_task_switching
description: Calls the exec Permit routine through the library base to re-enable task switching.

name: allocate_memory_block
description: Calls the exec AllocMem routine through the library base to obtain a memory block, passing its arguments straight through.

name: free_memory_block
description: Calls the exec FreeMem routine through the library base to release a memory block, passing its arguments straight through.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies a null-terminated string from the second pointer into the first, including the terminating zero.

name: append_null_terminated_string
description: Advances to the terminating zero of the first string and copies the second string onto its end through the copy routine.

name: stub_tail_call_forward
description: Only forwards control to another routine with no arguments and returns nothing of its own.

name: count_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a null-terminated string, excluding the terminator, and returns the count.

name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated strings and returns zero when they are equal, one when the first differing character of the first string is greater, and minus one when it is smaller.

name: compare_preceding_char_order
description: Compares the byte just before one pointer with the byte at another pointer, returning minus one when the first is smaller and one otherwise.

name: find_char_in_string
description: Scans a null-terminated string for the first occurrence of a given character and returns a pointer to it, or null when it is absent.

name: find_next_char_occurrence
description: Scans forward past the current position for the character held in a register, returning its position or null at the terminator.

name: stub_return_zero_result
description: Returns zero immediately without any other work.

name: find_last_char_in_string
description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a null-terminated string by measuring its length and scanning backward, returning a pointer or null.

name: scan_backward_for_char
description: Scans backward from a pointer toward a lower bound for a given byte, returning its position or null when it is not found.

name: stub_return_zero_unused
description: Returns zero immediately without any other work.

name: locate_path_separator
description: Searches a path string for a slash or a colon by calling the character search twice, returning a pointer to the first one found or the original pointer when neither is present.

name: stub_return_void_empty
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: stub_forward_call_entry
description: Forwards to another routine with no arguments and then returns.

name: stub_forward_call_handler
description: Forwards to another routine with no arguments and then returns.

name: run_program_startup_sequence
description: Program entry point that saves the startup globals and task state, opens the libraries it needs, runs the main setup, and closes the libraries before returning.

name: take_over_display_then_restore
description: Opens the libraries and the workbench, takes over the display and task priority, frees the copper and viewport lists, writes the DMA control register and waits on a message port; it then restores the workbench and closes the libraries.

name: try_lock_then_open_file
description: Repeatedly tries a dos Lock on a named file with busy-waiting between attempts; once the lock succeeds it unlocks the file and opens it, returning the handle, otherwise it restores the workbench and returns zero.

name: stub_return_void_handler
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: load_art_screen_or_restore
description: Tries to load the DF0:PDArtWork/LoadScrn32 screen file and, if that fails, restores the workbench state and closes the libraries; on success it only runs three finishing calls.

name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls three routines in sequence without arguments and returns.

name: advance_pseudo_random_state
description: Advances a 16-bit state word held in the caller's structure with a multiply-and-add step and returns the new state, shifted by a count taken from a register.

name: stub_return_empty_interrupt
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: install_interrupt_handler_vectors
description: Clears two counters, saves four existing vector values, stores handler pointers into the interrupt tables and installs them through exec SetIntVector and AddIntServer calls, then runs a further setup routine.

name: restore_interrupts_and_vectors
description: Removes the interrupt servers, writes disable masks to the custom chip control registers, and restores the vector values saved earlier through exec SetIntVector.

name: stub_return_empty_slot
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: poll_mouse_and_button_state
description: Reads the fire-button port and the mouse counter register, accumulates the horizontal and vertical movement into state words, and records whether the button or movement changed for the input routines.

name: stub_return_empty_hook
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: decode_keyboard_serial_byte
description: Reads the keyboard serial register, inverts and rotates the code, and either sets or clears the flag bits for two special keys or appends the translated character to a ring buffer.

name: update_flag_bit_two
description: Clears or sets the second flag bit of the flag word depending on the top bit of the value passed in a register.

name: update_flag_bit_zero
description: Clears or sets the lowest flag bit of the flag word depending on the top bit of the value passed in a register.

name: or_value_into_flags
description: ORs a register value into the flag word used by the key and button handlers.

name: append_table_entry_to_buffer
description: When the top bit of the register is clear, looks up a character in a table at a scaled index, adjusts it by a flag bit, and appends it to a ring buffer, wrapping the write position.

name: check_key_buffer_pending
description: Returns zero when the read and write positions of the input ring buffer are equal, meaning empty, and minus one when a character is waiting.

name: wait_read_buffer_byte
description: Waits until the input ring buffer holds a character, returns the next byte and advances the read position with wraparound.

name: acknowledge_audio_channel_zero
description: Acknowledges the audio channel zero interrupt request and adjusts that channel's nesting count: while the count is non-zero it decrements it and re-enables the interrupt, otherwise it resets the count and disables the channel's DMA.

name: release_audio_channel_zero_dma
description: Decrements the nesting count for audio channel zero and writes its DMA mask without the set bit, which disables that channel's DMA.

name: acknowledge_audio_channel_one
description: Acknowledges the audio channel one interrupt request and adjusts that channel's nesting count, re-enabling the interrupt while the count is non-zero and otherwise resetting it and disabling the channel's DMA.

name: release_audio_channel_one_dma
description: Decrements the nesting count for audio channel one and writes its DMA mask without the set bit, which disables that channel's DMA.

name: acknowledge_audio_channel_two
description: Acknowledges the audio channel two interrupt request and adjusts that channel's nesting count, re-enabling the interrupt while the count is non-zero and otherwise resetting it and disabling the channel's DMA.

name: release_audio_channel_two_dma
description: Decrements the nesting count for audio channel two and writes its DMA mask without the set bit, which disables that channel's DMA.

name: acknowledge_audio_channel_three
description: Acknowledges the audio channel three interrupt request and adjusts that channel's nesting count, re-enabling the interrupt while the count is non-zero and otherwise resetting it and disabling the channel's DMA.

name: release_audio_channel_three_dma
description: Decrements the nesting count for audio channel three and writes its DMA mask without the set bit, which disables that channel's DMA.

name: ramp_audio_channel_volumes
description: Writes the shared volume level to each audio channel volume register selected by a mask, then steps the volume up or down by one and stops the ramp when it reaches its limit.

name: accumulate_cia_timer_ticks
description: Reads the low timer bytes of the CIA time-of-day counter, computes the change since the previous call and adds it, scaled by four, to a running tick total.

name: advance_buffer_read_offset
description: Advances a read offset by an even step taken from a register and returns the previous offset plus a fixed base, or minus one when the new offset passes its limit.

name: allocate_block_shrinking_size
description: Requests a memory block of a fixed size through exec AllocMem and, on failure, retries with the size reduced by a thousand bytes until it succeeds or the size runs out, then releases the libraries and returns.

name: set_up_display_buffers
description: Obtains the colour map through a graphics call, checks the results of a long sequence of library calls, and sets up eight consecutive buffer offsets and initial counters within a block, returning its base or minus one on failure.

name: load_pitback_art_once
description: When the pit-back art flag is clear, calls a routine to load the DF0:PDArtWork/PitBack artwork and sets the flag to mark it as loaded.

name: switch_to_mirror_art
description: When the mirror art flag is clear, calls a routine to load the DF0:PDArtWork/Mirror artwork, sets the mirror flag and clears the pit-back flag.

name: record_table_entry_size
description: Writes a twelve-byte table entry at the index in a register, stores the running offset and a second value, obtains a size from a routine and, when it fits under the limit, records and returns half of it, otherwise returns minus one.

name: stub_return_minus_one
description: Returns minus one without other work.

name: run_sound_load_steps
description: Runs two routines for the DF0:PDData/Sounds data and, when the extra-sound flag is set, runs two more.

name: run_extra_sound_steps
description: When the extra-sound flag is set, runs two routines for the DF0:PDData/Sounds2 data.

name: offset_sound_table_entries
description: Calls one routine, then adds its result to the third word of each of twenty-nine twelve-byte entries in the DF0:PDData/Sounds3 table.

name: add_base_to_table_entries
description: Adds the base pointer value to the third word of each of twenty-nine twelve-byte table entries starting at the given pointer.

name: flip_top_bit_of_buffer
description: Obtains a byte count from a routine and subtracts 128 from each byte in the buffer, which flips their top bit, then calls one more routine.

name: seek_read_close_file_pair
description: Obtains a file handle from a routine, seeks within the file three times, reads a value and closes the file, returning the two values obtained, or minus one when no handle is available.

name: seek_read_close_file_triple
description: Obtains a file handle, seeks three times, reads and closes the file, returning two values, or minus one when no handle is available.

name: stub_return_void_entry
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: read_demo_lap_file
description: Opens the DF0:PDData/Demo.Lap file through a routine and, when the handle is valid, reads from it twice and closes it, returning zero, or minus one when it cannot be opened.

name: read_high_scores_table
description: Opens the DF0:PDData/HighScores.Tab file, reads from it twice, closes it and runs one more routine, returning zero, or minus one when the file cannot be opened.

name: write_high_scores_table
description: Writes the DF0:PDData/HighScores.Tab file: when the first byte of the buffer is an asterisk it writes two blocks, then closes the file, returning zero, or minus one when the file cannot be opened.

name: xor_scramble_buffer_bytes
description: Exclusive-ORs the first 220 bytes of the buffer with a fixed key byte, so applying it a second time restores the original data.

name: read_twelve_blocks_from_file
description: Obtains a file handle through a routine, reads twelve blocks from it, closes it and returns zero, or minus one when no handle is available.

name: read_nine_blocks_from_file
description: Obtains a file handle through a routine, reads nine blocks from it, closes it and returns zero, or minus one when no handle is available.

name: read_and_offset_table_entries
description: Opens a file through a routine, then for each entry of a table sized by a count it reads a block and adds a constant to the 32-bit entry, reading further blocks afterwards before closing; it resets the count and returns minus one when the file is unavailable.

name: build_padded_bob_path_name
description: Copies an eight-byte space-padded name after the DF0:PDBOBS/ prefix, turning spaces into terminators, then stores the result of a routine in the table slot at the index passed in a register.

name: store_result_in_table_slot
description: Calls a routine and, when the index passed in a register is non-negative, stores the result in the table slot at that index.

name: build_bob_path_name
description: Copies an eight-byte space-padded name after the DF0:PDBOBS/ prefix, turning spaces into terminators, then calls one routine.

name: load_bob_library_chain
description: Runs a long chain of file and library calls in order, stopping at the first failure, and closes the file afterwards; the decompiled listing is cut off partway through, so only the opening steps are certain.

name: load_top_racer_frame
description: Sets the frame offset from the current position, then loads the TopRacer0 bob data and its TopRacer0TP companion through two routines, returning the first result.

name: load_inset_bob_image
description: Sets the frame offset from the current position, then loads the DF0:PDBobs/Inset image and stores the handle it returns.

name: load_tv_banner_bobs
description: Saves the current offset state, sets a new base offset for the TV and banner art, loads the TVBack, Banner and TeeVee files through two routines, then restores the saved offsets.

name: load_bob_library_two
description: Saves the offset state, runs a chain of routines to load the DF0:PDArtwork/BobLib2 bob library, then restores the state and closes the file, returning minus one if any step fails.

name: parse_command_record_stream
description: Reads a sequence of codes from a stream until it ends; the special code 12345 preserves a stored field, while other codes trigger one or two routines, with an extra routine for codes two to four.

name: fill_four_by_sixteen_table
description: Fills a four-by-sixteen table of 32-bit entries, storing in each cell the row index times four plus a 16-bit value read from a source table with a stride of twenty-four bytes.

name: store_pair_then_call
description: Stores two register values into a pair of globals and then calls one routine.

name: load_file_chunk_then_close
description: Stores two argument values, obtains a file handle through a routine and, when it is valid, runs one more routine and closes the file, returning its result; otherwise it calls Forbid and returns zero.

name: read_bitmap_planes_from_file
description: Reads a chunked image file through the dos seek and read calls, processes the chunk codes, initialises a bitmap with graphics InitBitMap, sets the plane pointers at the computed row size, then ORs four bitplanes into one combined buffer.

name: combine_stored_bitplane_rows
description: If a bitmap record is present, ORs its four bitplane rows into the destination row buffer, using the row count stored in the record.

name: find_iff_chunk_tag_index
description: Looks up a four-character IFF chunk identifier in a six-entry table of known tags (FORM, ILBM, BMHD, CMAP, GRAB, BODY) and returns its index, or minus one when it is unknown.

name: repeat_output_group_calls
description: Repeats a group of four routine calls per iteration over a counter, with an extra call per iteration when a mode value is above four.

name: unpack_packbits_row
description: Unpacks one row of run-length encoded image data: a positive count copies that many literal bytes, a negative count repeats the next byte, and a flag selects a plain word copy instead.

name: load_cockpit_art_flagged
description: Loads the DF0:PDArtWork/Cockpit artwork through one routine; when the mode flag is set it first marks a byte flag and then makes the call.

name: advance_cockpit_offset
description: Loads the DF0:PDArtWork/Cockpit artwork through one routine, then advances the cockpit offset by one hundred and sixteen bytes.

name: fill_bytes_from_routine_values
description: Fills a 65536-byte region by writing values from one routine to two pointers at each step, then keeps copying words from another routine in an endless loop.

name: initialise_bitmap_plane_pointers
description: Initialises a bitmap structure through graphics InitBitMap and computes five plane pointers at a fixed stride, returning zero, or minus one when the size is not positive.

name: build_game_display_view
description: Builds the display: frees old copper lists, obtains a colour map, initialises the view, rastport and viewport structures, makes and merges the copper list, loads the view and records a 320-pixel-wide display of height 200.

name: rebuild_display_view
description: Rebuilds the display view: obtains a colour map if none is held, initialises the viewport, makes and merges the copper list, and loads the view.

name: reload_view_and_copper
description: Sets the display mode values, then makes and merges the copper list and loads the view through graphics calls.

name: set_display_mode_four
description: Sets the display mode variables to the four-mode value and loads the view.

name: update_frame_time_delta
description: Computes the elapsed time since the last frame from the running tick total, clamps it between eight and fifty, stores it, and swaps two saved view-list pointers depending on a toggle flag.

name: load_view_and_clear_flag
description: Calls one routine, loads the graphics view and clears a state byte.

name: wait_and_release_copper_lists
description: Saves the current copper list pointers, initialises the view, runs one of two routine sets depending on a flag, waits for the bottom of the viewport, reloads the view and frees the copper and viewport lists.

name: make_viewport_and_copper
description: Clears the copper and viewport pointers, makes a viewport and merges the copper list through graphics calls, then saves the resulting pointers.

name: make_second_viewport_copper
description: Makes a second viewport and copper list through graphics calls, merging them and saving the resulting pointers in the second slot.

name: swap_viewport_copper_lists
description: Restores the saved copper pointers, rebuilds the viewport and copper list, loads the view after waiting for the bottom of the viewport, and frees the previous lists when they have changed.

name: dispatch_command_character_loop
description: Reads one character code at a time from a stream and dispatches each through a chain of comparisons, with several codes calling routines and one code returning minus one; the decompiled listing is cut off, so only this dispatch structure is certain.

name: clear_flag_then_run_four
description: Clears a flag word and then calls four routines in sequence.

name: forward_call_with_registers
description: Calls one routine and then forwards the current register state to a second routine, returning the register pair.

name: compute_byte_checksum
description: Computes a checksum by summing the bytes of a fixed address range in the program image and returns the total.

name: store_checksum_result
description: Calls one routine and stores its result in the caller's structure at a fixed offset.

name: verify_checksum_then_dispatch
description: Recomputes a value through one routine and returns it when it matches the stored value; otherwise it runs the same character dispatch loop, whose listing is cut off.

name: stub_return_void_gap
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: store_fixed_constant_global
description: Stores a fixed 32-bit constant into a global variable and returns.

name: check_original_disk_present
description: Compares a value read from the disk with a stored identifier and, when they differ, flags the original disk as missing; the referenced prompts ask for the original disk to be in drive A.

name: stub_forward_two_calls
description: Forwards to two other routines in sequence and then returns.

name: trigger_timed_routine
description: When a counter is positive and the enable word is set, and forty ticks have passed since the last trigger or a force flag is set, records the current tick time, calls one routine with the next time and clears its busy flag.

name: stub_forward_single_call
description: Forwards to one other routine and then returns.

name: lookup_word_table_into_field
description: Copies a 16-bit value from a global table, indexed by a stored word, into a field of the structure.

name: stub_forward_call_slot
description: Forwards to one other routine and then returns.

name: copy_table_word_into_field
description: Copies a 16-bit value from a global table, indexed by a stored word, into a field of the structure; it behaves the same as the sibling lookup routine.

name: store_three_values_minus_bias
description: Calls one routine three times and stores each result, reduced by two hundred and fifty-six, into three consecutive fields.

name: next_random_scaled_value
description: Advances a 16-bit state with a multiply-and-add step and returns the high half of the masked state multiplied by a register value, scaled by two.

name: blit_clamped_offset_element
description: When the active flag is clear, clamps a stored offset between minus five and five, passes it with fixed numeric arguments to a graphics blit through a library vector, then calls another routine.

name: call_with_swapped_saved_pointers
description: Temporarily swaps a pair of saved pointers in the structure with an alternate pair, calls one routine, then restores the original pair.

name: blit_fixed_region_bitmap
description: Obtains a bitmap from one routine and blits a fixed region of it with graphics BltBitMap using fixed coordinates, then calls one more routine.

name: draw_object_list_records
description: Sets a timing field and, when the object flag is clear, passes each record of a linked list through one routine with fixed arguments, then restores the timing field to a fixed value.

name: draw_counted_entries
description: Calls one routine once per entry with fixed arguments, counting down from a stored count, after temporarily swapping in a saved pointer.

name: stub_return_no_action
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: stub_return_no_action_two
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Computes the integer square root of a non-negative value by testing bits from the highest to the lowest, keeping the largest root whose square does not exceed the value.

name: stub_return_no_action_three
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: send_serial_byte
description: Waits until the previous serial transmission has finished, marks the transmit flag, then writes the byte with a ninth bit set to the serial data register.

name: enable_serial_transmit_interrupt
description: Clears the serial transmit flag and enables the transmit-buffer-empty interrupt in the interrupt enable register.

name: initialise_serial_port_state
description: Sets the serial period register to a fixed divider, clears the receive and transmit state fields, and enables the serial receive and transmit interrupts.

name: handle_serial_receive_byte
description: Serial receive interrupt routine: reads the incoming byte, stores it in an eighty-entry ring buffer or runs a small state machine that collects a packet, then clears the receive interrupt request.

name: store_field_and_rearm_receive
description: Stores a 16-bit argument into a receive state field and writes the interrupt control bits that re-arm the receive interrupt.

name: decode_serial_command_byte
description: Converts the incoming character by subtracting forty-two and looks it up in a table, setting state fields according to whether the entry is a marker, a command or unknown, then re-arms the receive interrupt.

name: reset_serial_receive_fields
description: Clears the four receive state fields to their idle values and re-arms the receive interrupt.

name: append_serial_byte_to_buffer
description: Appends the received byte to the eighty-entry ring buffer, wrapping the write index, then re-arms the receive interrupt.

name: check_serial_buffer_empty
description: Returns zero when the serial receive ring buffer is empty, meaning its read and write indices are equal, and minus one when data is waiting.

name: read_serial_buffer_byte
description: Waits until the serial receive ring buffer holds a byte, returns it and advances the read index with wraparound at eighty entries.

name: service_pending_serial_request
description: When the serial session flag is set, clears a pending-done flag or, when a request flag is set, runs the request routines and clears that flag.

name: dispatch_serial_packet_commands
description: Reads a packet with timeout counters, decodes its command code by subtracting forty-two, and dispatches it to a chain of cases that copy table data, update state fields and call routines; the listing is cut off partway, so only the opening branches are certain.

name: forward_bytes_until_zero
description: Repeatedly calls one routine for up to forty bytes, passing each result to another routine, and stops early when the first routine returns zero.

name: send_counted_serial_block
description: Adds forty-two to the first byte of the buffer, then sends the buffer's counted bytes through the serial transmit routine, waiting for each transmission to finish, and runs two more routines when a flag is set.

name: fill_buffer_until_timeout
description: Writes the current status byte into the buffer repeatedly, calling one routine per step, until the timeout passes or the state byte reaches four.

name: set_state_four_and_call
description: Sets the global state value to four and calls one routine.

name: dispatch_serial_state_byte
description: Handles the current serial state byte: in the idle state it dispatches received command codes to copy table data and call routines, in the active state it copies status fields, and it returns the state; the listing is cut off partway.

name: store_status_fields_and_call
description: Sets a mode byte to one, or to eleven when one of two state fields is set, copies six state fields into the output globals and calls one routine.

name: run_mode_eight_until_timeout
description: Saves and clears a field, sets the mode to eight and runs one routine, stepping it until eight hundred ticks pass or the state byte reaches twenty-four, then restores the field.

name: begin_timed_state_transition
description: Saves and clears a field, copies two state words into the output globals, sets the mode to twenty-six with a timer of two thousand four hundred ticks, then runs one routine and restores the field.

name: copy_ten_byte_block_flagged
description: When the state flag is negative, copies a ten-byte block from a fixed buffer into the global output area.

name: toggle_active_state_flags
description: Either clears the active state and runs its teardown routines, or sets the active flag, clears its fields and runs a setup routine, depending on the state flag.

name: read_text_entries_with_timeout
description: Reads characters one at a time with per-character timeouts until a period is read, copying nine-byte name blocks when a code of sixteen arrives, and gives up after an overall limit of two thousand ticks.

name: wait_twelve_frames
description: Waits for the vertical blank twelve times through the graphics library WaitTOF call.

name: stub_return_no_action_four
description: Empty routine that returns at once, doing nothing.

name: compute_clamped_magnitude_delta
description: Returns the absolute value of a stored field's high byte together with sixty minus that magnitude, clamped to zero when the magnitude exceeds sixty.

name: update_object_motion_state
description: Updates a moving object's position and velocity each step, checks proximity to other records using summed absolute offsets, adjusts speed on a close match and stores the display coordinates; the listing is cut off partway.

name: initialise_object_offsets_once
description: On the first call for an object, clears its counters, sets its step parameters to ten and twenty, and stores three offsets from routine values, each reduced by sixty-four.

name: initialise_object_defaults
description: On the first call for an object, sets its step parameters and fixed offsets, with the first position offset set to minus eighty.

name: set_object_step_parameters
description: Sets an object's step and velocity parameters, negating some of them depending on the low bits of a direction word.

name: initialise_object_random_offsets
description: On the first call, sets the timing fields and stores three values from routine results, each reduced by two hundred and fifty-five, plus a fourth value that is negated when it is below three.

name: update_status_flag_bits
description: Advances three counters by fixed steps, sets status flag bits in a word whenever a counter reaches its limit, then calls two routines.

name: initialise_object_record
description: Sets an object record's identifiers to minus one and zero, calls a setup routine, marks the record active and records its pointer.

name: project_point_into_tables
description: Computes two projected coordinates from table lookups, a scale and a divisor, and stores each in a table indexed by the projected value.

name: initialise_projection_tables
description: On the first call, fills several per-column tables with routine values offset by fixed amounts and sets the table counts from the input value.

name: update_perspective_rows
description: Steps through a run of rows, adding table deltas to their positions and decaying their counters, then passes each active row through a perspective calculation to a further routine.

name: advance_row_tables_per_frame
description: Runs one frame of table updates: advances an offset, writes two hundred rows of projected values into the tables, and calls several routines to finish the frame.

name: read_selection_byte
description: Calls two routines to advance state, then stores into a field a byte chosen by a flag from one of two routine results.

name: step_visible_entries_per_frame
description: Advances the per-entry tables by one step: for each active entry it adds the velocity values to its positions, decrements its remaining lifetime and calls a routine.

name: reset_entry_tables_with_timer
description: Sets five hundred and one table entries to minus one, clears the two counters and sets the timer to the current tick plus three thousand.
